issues.problem: Result value 作文が上手に書けるようになりました marked the adverbial に of the na-adjective 上手 as a ni-change particle slot; it is not a separate particle (only 上手になる is ni-change).
issues.action: Removed the slot markup: 上手[じょうず]に書[か]けるようになりました.

issues.problem: Focus slot accepted only にとって, but には is equally natural with the same meaning in every combination (この辞書は子供には難しいです), so a learner typing it would be marked wrong.
issues.action: Added には as an alternative to the nitotte focus slot. Distractors unchanged.
